pages.text: Seventeen in it. $(bold)Rounds$() go in your pocket first: right-click a handful to pocket them, sneak to pocket the lot. $(bold)R$() reloads from the pocket.$(br)The soldiers and the scavengers carry the same rounds; so does the brick works.$(br)$(bold)If you die$() you wake in the yard with the pistol, loaded, and this notebook. Everything else lies where you fell.
